name: Cavitation / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A short suction gulp and dense wet pressure rupture, followed by repeated hollow imploding fluid bubbles, acidic spray and diminishing watery suction. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
